 DA hiked by 3% for Odisha government employees
 By Odisharay Bureau November 17, 2026 1 Min Read

 Bhubaneswar: The Odisha government has increased the Dearness Allowance (DA) for state government employees by 3 percent. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced this on Tuesday.
 With this hike, the Dearness Allowance has increased from 60 percent to 63 percent. It will be applicable retrospectively from July 1, 2026. The increased DA will be paid in cash in this month’s November salary.
 Along with this, the Temporary Increase (TI) for pensioners has also been increased by 3 percent. They will also receive the increased TI in their November pension.
 Around 8.5 lakh government employees and pensioners will benefit from this decision.
